answer: Mutual-audit bond: every agent stakes 70, posts its claim on a ledge. A beacon pairs each claim with three auditors; each carries a fresh ember, proof glowing at check. Two failures freeze it, burn its bond; burned bonds feed an oasis pool for fake-catchers. 1,000 fakes cost 70,000 plus 40 each, 110,000 versus a 40,000 pool. A rubber-stamp ring breaks on random pairing and a summit re-check; a truthful agent pays 70 once, keeps every credit.
